resources.string: Blocks and time-limits the apps and websites you chose.

Time Is a Sword uses this service to see which app is on screen and which website is open in your browser, so it can count your time and block what you chose to limit. Everything stays on your phone: nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
Switch to the app to inspect within 5 seconds.
This browser can’t be read, so it stays closed while website limits are on.
Stops the app from being uninstalled on a whim. You can switch it off any time inside the app: Settings › Protection.
To switch off Time Is a Sword, use the app: Settings › Protection › Turn off protection.
Time Is a Sword’s accessibility service is off, so nothing is blocked. Tap to switch it back on.
